nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _tOwned; token balances for excluded accounts
bool public canTrade = false; trading gate
address public marketingWallet; receives ETH share
SHIBARONIN constructor: mints _rTotal to deployer, creates uniswap pair, sets fee exclusions

airdrop(address,uint256) external onlyOwner, removes all fees and transfers

claimOtherTokens(IERC20,address) onlyOwner transfers arbitrary token balance

tokenAddress.transfer(walletaddress, balanceOf(this)) arbitrary external token call

_lockTime = block.timestamp + time arithmetic on miner controlled timestamp
swapAndLiquify external ETH transfers while lockTheSwap only guards itself
privileged onlyOwner surface reachable with owner key
newBalance -= marketingshare and amount + balanceOf(to) arithmetic
canTrade gate requiring sender == owner in _tokenTransfer
